description: Human-readable display name for the skill. If omitted, the directory name is used. Shown in skill listings and menus.

claude-code.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (optional, falls back to directory name; lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only, max 64 characters)

cline.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required) — must exactly match the directory name

codex.mechanism: YAML frontmatter key: name (optional — falls back to parent directory name if absent or empty; max 64 chars enforced after whitespace normalization)

copilot-cli.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required per Agent Skills open standard)

crush.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required); follows the Anthropic Agent Skills standard. Validated: must be alphanumeric with hyphens, max 64 chars.

cursor.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required); matches the skill directory name per the Agent Skills convention.

devin.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required). Must be lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (e.g., deploy-to-staging, code-review). Used in UI listings and for @-mentions.

factory-droid.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (optional, defaults to directory name)

gemini-cli.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required); value should match the skill's directory name

kiro.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required, slug-style identifier)

pi.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required, max 64 chars, lowercase a-z/0-9/hyphens, must match parent directory name)

roo-code.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required); identifies the skill and typically matches the directory name

zed.mechanism: yaml frontmatter key: name (required). Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; 1-64 characters; no leading/trailing or consecutive hyphens. Should match the skill's folder name and doubles as the skill identifier; skills with invalid names fail to load.
